newsitem.title: USA: SITEL Q2 includes transaction expenses.
newsitem.headline: SITEL Q2 includes transaction expenses.

text.p: SITEL Corp, a provider of outsourced telephone-based customer service, posted lower earnings of $1.1 million or $0.02 a share compared to $2.8 million or $0.04 a share a year ago for the November 30 second quarter.
Excluding $5.7 million of nonrecurring transaction expenses relating primarily to the acquisition of Mitre Plc, the company had net 1996 income of $6.8 million, it said.
Excluding non-recurring transaction expenses, 1996 per share earnings were $0.10 a share.

"During the second quarter we continued the integration of our earlier strategic business combinations," SITEL chairman James Lynch said in a statement. "Our operating results were very strong, with an excellent increase in operating income as a percent of revenues."
